scope: Nine Python checks of the existing calibration wrapper: retain native stdout/stderr on failures and captured byte prefixes on timeout; reject malformed, non-object, duplicate-key or incomplete reports even on native exit zero; distinguish worker and wrapper exit codes. Successful mocked report remains calibrated:false and credit:false. Candidate snapshot, provenance early failure, no overwrite, and failed table publication regressions are retained. Native worker/weight validation are mocked in the report cases; no real model, native calibration run, hardware or spending credit.

runs.command: ulimit -v 2097152; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 timeout 60s pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_c71_calibration.py -k 'trial_output or failed_table or weight_provenance'

accounting_scope: No protocol, canonical operation/reservation, resource ledger or calibration authorization change. No Rust rebuild: only Python failure handling and its mocked checks changed.
